note: Each tail (673k, never closed) = Sinkhorn 567k + exp/fdiv/regs.  The Sinkhorn is cut along its own dataflow: step-0 general datapath (cycles A, B: 16 SUBN quotients) | steady step + matrix state + control (16 lean quotients); the one-step-per-clock loop st -> step -> st stays inside sk_steady.  Root glue (95.7k incl. 2 SRAM) stays flat.
